project_title: Machine learning prediction of absence of formal healthcare seeking for acutely ill children in sub-Saharan Africa: a 38-country internal-external cross-validation study

computational_benchmarks.reference_hardware: Intel Xeon @ 2.50 GHz (8 cores, 16 threads), 32 GB RAM, SSD storage

expected_runtimes_8core_cpu.iecv_38country_lightgbm: 4.2 - 6.0 minutes total (~6.5 - 9.5 seconds per held-out country)

memory_footprint.disk_space_required: ~1.5 GB code and extracted parquet (raw DHS zips require ~4.5 GB)

random_seeds_policy.iecv_country_loop: Deterministic alphabetical sort by ISO-2 country code
